points.description: Gives the domain as the closed interval [1/2, 4/3], i.e. 1/2 ≤ x ≤ 4/3, with both endpoints written as common fractions. The student must reach this by valid reasoning, such as requiring -6x^2+11x-4 ≥ 0, factoring to (2x-1)(3x-4) ≤ 0 or using the quadratic formula, and checking the sign. Equivalent correct forms (e.g. {x : 1/2 ≤ x ≤ 4/3}) earn the mark. An answer with a wrong endpoint, open or half-open brackets, or mixed numbers or decimals for the endpoints does not earn it.

rubric.notes: The mark is all-or-nothing: full marks only for the correct closed interval [1/2, 4/3] with every step valid and endpoints as common fractions. Any valid method (factoring, quadratic formula, sign table) is acceptable, and equivalent notation is accepted. Any wrong endpoint, wrong interval type, or invalid step earns no mark.
